thread.title: Whip yourself into shape by using this Apple Watch feature to compete against friends and family

author: Todd Haselton
title: Whip yourself into shape by using this Apple Watch feature to compete against friends and family
text: Whip yourself into shape by using this Apple Watch feature to compete against friends and family Todd Haselton Reblog The Apple Watch has an Activity app that you can use to compete with people. The Apple AAPL Watch is already one of my favorite tech products -- I wear one every day -- and I recently started using a feature that's made it even more fun: Activity Sharing. You probably already use the Activity app on your Apple Watch.
